description: The provider template opencode writes for a hosted or campus server, with placeholders for the URL, the key, and the model name that you fill in yourself.

steps.description: This is the template opencode writes when you ask it to add a provider. It is an OpenAI-compatible provider named `campus`, with placeholder values you replace yourself, and a hosted provider needs three things: its URL, your key, and the model's name.
The provider is named `campus`, and `npm` is `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`, the adapter package that speaks the endpoint's dialect.

`options` holds `baseURL` as `PASTE-PROVIDER-URL` and `apiKey` as `PASTE-YOUR-KEY`, both placeholders. The page says never type or paste a key into an opencode prompt, because everything typed there goes to the provider and stays in the session history.
`models` maps `PASTE-MODEL-NAME` to a display name, `campus model`, so the model is listed under the provider once you restart.
